function initGovernance() {
  const tabVote = document.getElementById('governance-tab-vote');
  const tabSuggest = document.getElementById('governance-tab-suggest');
  const contentVote = document.getElementById('governance-content-vote');
  const contentSuggest = document.getElementById('governance-content-suggest');

  if (!tabVote || !tabSuggest || !contentVote || !contentSuggest) return;

  tabVote.addEventListener('click', () => {
    tabVote.classList.add('active');
    tabSuggest.classList.remove('active');
    contentVote.style.display = 'block';
    contentSuggest.style.display = 'none';
    fetchAndRenderPolls();
  });

  tabSuggest.addEventListener('click', () => {
    tabSuggest.classList.add('active');
    tabVote.classList.remove('active');
    contentSuggest.style.display = 'block';
    contentVote.style.display = 'none';
  });

  // Initial fetch of polls
  fetchAndRenderPolls();

  // Handle vote submit
  const voteForm = document.getElementById('governance-vote-form');
  if (voteForm) {
    voteForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const selectedOpt = document.querySelector('input[name="poll-option"]:checked');
      if (!selectedOpt) return;

      const optionId = selectedOpt.value;

      fetch('/api/polls/vote', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ pollId: 'poll-1', optionId })
      })
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to vote');
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(updatedPoll => {
        showToast('🗳️ Your vote was recorded anonymously. Thank you for participating!', 'success');
        renderPollResults(updatedPoll);
        localStorage.setItem('has-voted-poll-1', 'true');
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error voting:', err);
        showToast('❌ Failed to record vote. Please try again.', 'error');
      });
    });
  }

  // Handle suggestion submit
  const suggestForm = document.getElementById('governance-suggest-form');
  if (suggestForm) {
    suggestForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const category = document.getElementById('sug-category').value;
      const title = document.getElementById('sug-title').value;
      const text = document.getElementById('sug-text').value;

      fetch('/api/suggestions', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ category, title, text })
      })
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to submit suggestion');
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(newSug => {
        showToast('📝 Anonymous suggestion submitted to Gram Sabha registry successfully!', 'success');
        suggestForm.reset();
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error submitting suggestion:', err);
        showToast('❌ Failed to submit suggestion. Please try again.', 'error');
      });
    });
  }
}

function fetchAndRenderPolls() {
  fetch('/api/polls')
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(polls => {
    const poll = polls['poll-1'];
    if (!poll) return;

    // Set question text based on active language
    const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
    const qEl = document.getElementById('gov-poll-question');
    if (qEl) {
      qEl.textContent = `Poll: ${poll.question[lang] || poll.question['en']}`;
    }

    // Set option labels
    poll.options.forEach((opt, idx) => {
      const lbl = document.getElementById(`lbl-poll-opt-${idx + 1}`);
      if (lbl) {
        lbl.textContent = opt.text[lang] || opt.text['en'];
      }
    });

    // If already voted, show results directly
    if (localStorage.getItem('has-voted-poll-1') === 'true') {
      renderPollResults(poll);
    }
  })
  .catch(err => console.error('Error loading polls:', err));
}

function renderPollResults(poll) {
  const voteForm = document.getElementById('governance-vote-form');
  const resultsPanel = document.getElementById('poll-results-panel');
  const resultsBars = document.getElementById('poll-results-bars');

  if (!resultsBars) return;

  if (voteForm) voteForm.style.display = 'none';
  if (resultsPanel) resultsPanel.style.display = 'block';

  resultsBars.innerHTML = '';

  const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
  const totalVotes = poll.options.reduce((sum, opt) => sum + (opt.votes || 0), 0) || 1;

  poll.options.forEach(opt => {
    const pct = Math.round(((opt.votes || 0) / totalVotes) * 100);
    const labelText = opt.text[lang] || opt.text['en'];

    const barWrapper = document.createElement('div');
    barWrapper.className = 'poll-result-bar-wrapper';
    barWrapper.innerHTML = `
      <div class="poll-result-meta">
        <span>${labelText}</span>
        <span class="poll-result-votes">${pct}% (${opt.votes || 0} ${lang === 'hi' ? 'मत' : lang === 'te' ? 'ఓట్లు' : 'votes'})</span>
      </div>
      <div class="poll-result-bar-bg">
        <div class="poll-result-bar-fill" style="width: 0%;"></div>
      </div>
    `;
    resultsBars.appendChild(barWrapper);

    // Trigger width transition in next tick
    setTimeout(() => {
      const fillEl = barWrapper.querySelector('.poll-result-bar-fill');
      if (fillEl) fillEl.style.width = `${pct}%`;
    }, 50);
  });
}

/* ==========================================
   VILLAGE DASHBOARD CONTROLLER
   ========================================== */
function triggerGenderBarAnimation() {
  setTimeout(() => {
    const bar = document.getElementById('vd-gender-bar');
    if (bar) {
      const targetWidth = bar.style.width || '52%';
      bar.style.transition = 'none';
      bar.style.width = '0%';
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          bar.style.transition = 'width 1s ease';
          bar.style.width = targetWidth;
        });
      });
    }
  }, 100);
}

function initVillageDashboard() {
  // Setup sidebar tab switching
  const tabs = ['overview', 'statistics', 'education', 'schemes', 'announcements'];
  tabs.forEach(tabName => {
    const btn = document.getElementById(`vd-tab-${tabName}`);
    if (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        
        // Reset all buttons and sections
        tabs.forEach(t => {
          const b = document.getElementById(`vd-tab-${t}`);
          if (b) {
            b.classList.remove('active');
            b.style.color = 'var(--color-text-muted)';
            b.style.borderLeftColor = 'transparent';
          }
          const s = document.getElementById(`vd-sec-${t}`);
          if (s) s.style.display = 'none';
        });

        // Activate selected tab and section
        btn.classList.add('active');
        btn.style.color = 'var(--color-primary)';
        btn.style.borderLeftColor = 'var(--color-primary)';
        
        const sec = document.getElementById(`vd-sec-${tabName}`);
        if (sec) sec.style.display = 'block';

        // Re-trigger gender bar animation if statistics tab is selected
        if (tabName === 'statistics') {
          triggerGenderBarAnimation();
        }
      });
    }
  });
}

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      // 1. Sync theme preference from LocalStorage
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-theme');
      if (savedTheme === 'banjara' || (!savedTheme && document.body.classList.contains('banjara-active'))) {
        document.body.classList.add('banjara-active');
        document.getElementById('theme-btn-icon').textContent = '🌿';
        document.getElementById('theme-btn-text').textContent = 'Eco Theme';
      } else if (savedTheme === 'eco') {
        document.body.classList.remove('banjara-active');
      }

      // 2. Toggle Theme Listener
      const themeToggle = document.getElementById('btn-theme-toggle');
      themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isBanjara = document.body.classList.toggle('banjara-active');
        if (isBanjara) {
          localStorage.setItem('panchayat-theme', 'banjara');
          document.getElementById('theme-btn-icon').textContent = '🌿';
          document.getElementById('theme-btn-text').textContent = 'Eco Theme';
          showToast('✨ Banjara Cultural Theme activated: Crimson and shell-gold!', 'success');
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem('panchayat-theme', 'eco');
          document.getElementById('theme-btn-icon').textContent = '✨';
          document.getElementById('theme-btn-text').textContent = 'Banjara Theme';
          showToast('🌱 Eco Theme activated: Forest Green and Amber Gold!', 'success');
        }
        // Re-draw Charts to update theme colors
        renderAllCharts();
      });

      // 3. Initialize translation original texts
      const selectors = Object.keys(dashboardTranslations.hi);
      selectors.forEach(sel => {
        const el = document.querySelector(sel);
        if (el) {
          originalTexts[sel] = el.innerHTML.trim();
        }
      });

      // 4. Load saved language preference
      const savedLang = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-lang') || 'en';
      currentLanguage = savedLang;
      const select = document.getElementById('lang-select');
      if (select) {
        select.value = savedLang;
        select.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
          const lang = e.target.value;
          currentLanguage = lang;
          localStorage.setItem('panchayat-lang', lang);
          applyTranslation(lang);
          renderAlertsAndInsights();
          renderAnnouncements();
          // Update details panel
          const activeNode = document.querySelector('.twin-node.selected');
          if (activeNode) {
            updateDigitalTwinPane(activeNode.getAttribute('data-asset'));
          }
          const toastMsg = lang === 'hi' ? '🇮🇳 भाषा बदलकर हिंदी कर दी गई है।' : lang === 'te' ? '🇮🇳 భాష తెలుగులోకి మార్చబడింది.' : '🇬🇧 Language switched to English.';
          showToast(toastMsg, 'success');
        });
      }

      // 5. Mobile Navbar Toggle — screen-size-aware
      const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-toggle');
      const navLinksEl = document.getElementById('navigation-links');
      const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 950;

      function isMobile() {
        return window.innerWidth <= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT;
      }

      function closeMobileNav() {
        if (navLinksEl) navLinksEl.classList.remove('active');
        if (mobileToggle) {
          mobileToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          mobileToggle.textContent = '☰';
        }
      }

      if (mobileToggle && navLinksEl) {
        mobileToggle.textContent = '☰';

        mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const expanded = mobileToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
          mobileToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
          navLinksEl.classList.toggle('active');
          mobileToggle.textContent = !expanded ? '✕' : '☰';
        });

        // Close mobile nav when clicking any link inside it
        navLinksEl.querySelectorAll('a, button').forEach(el => {
          el.addEventListener('click', () => {
            closeMobileNav();
          });
        });

        // Close mobile nav when clicking outside
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (!isMobile()) return;
          if (!mobileToggle.contains(e.target) && !navLinksEl.contains(e.target)) {
            closeMobileNav();
          }
        });

        // Auto-close and reset when resizing to desktop
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          if (!isMobile()) {
            closeMobileNav();
          }
        });
      }

      // 6. Interactive Digital Twin Map Click handlers
      const mapNodes = document.querySelectorAll('.twin-node');
      mapNodes.forEach(node => {
        node.addEventListener('click', () => {
          mapNodes.forEach(n => n.classList.remove('selected'));
          node.classList.add('selected');
          const assetName = node.getAttribute('data-asset');
          updateDigitalTwinPane(assetName);
        });
      });

      // Select high school by default
      const defaultNode = document.getElementById('twin-node-school');
      if (defaultNode) {
        defaultNode.classList.add('selected');
        updateDigitalTwinPane('school');
      }

      // 7. Simulating checkbox logic
      document.getElementById('sim-solar-toggle').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        householdStats.solar = e.target.checked ? 0 : 15;
        updateDataElements();
      });
      document.getElementById('sim-toilet-toggle').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        householdStats.privateToilet = e.target.checked ? 100 : 83;
        updateDataElements();
      });
      document.getElementById('sim-water-toggle').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        householdStats.tapWater = e.target.checked ? 62 : 81;
        updateDataElements();
      });

      // 8. Generate Report listeners
      document.getElementById('btn-print-report').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());
      document.getElementById('btn-generate-report').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());

      // 9. Load API data on load
      loadDataFromApis();
    });

    function applyTranslation(lang) {
      currentLanguage = lang;
      document.body.classList.remove('lang-en', 'lang-hi', 'lang-te');
      document.body.classList.add('lang-' + lang);
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', lang);

      const selectors = Object.keys(dashboardTranslations.hi);
      selectors.forEach(sel => {
        const el = document.querySelector(sel);
        if (!el) return;

        if (lang === 'en') {
          if (originalTexts[sel]) {
            el.innerHTML = originalTexts[sel];
          }
        } else {
          if (dashboardTranslations[lang] && dashboardTranslations[lang][sel]) {
            el.innerHTML = dashboardTranslations[lang][sel];
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Load data from live Panchayat APIs
    function loadDataFromApis() {
      // Fetch dynamic configurations, updates, and grievances
      const fetchConfig = fetch('/api/main-page-config').then(r => r.json());
      const fetchUpdates = fetch('/api/household-updates').then(r => r.json());
      const fetchGrievances = fetch('/api/grievances').then(r => r.json());

      Promise.all([fetchConfig, fetchUpdates, fetchGrievances])
        .then(([config, updates, grievances]) => {
          // Store notices
          activeNotices = config.notices || [];

          // Map main page config stats to Overview cards target values
          if (config.stats) {
            const cleanNum = (str) => parseInt(str?.replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
            if (config.stats.population) {
              const popNum = cleanNum(config.stats.population.en || config.stats.population);
              document.getElementById('stat-val-population').setAttribute('data-target', popNum);
              educationData.illiterate = Math.round(popNum * (1 - 0.68)); // 32% illiteracy based on 68% rate
              document.getElementById('edu-val-illiterate').textContent = educationData.illiterate;
            }
            if (config.stats.families) {
              const famNum = cleanNum(config.stats.families.en || config.stats.families);
              document.getElementById('stat-val-families').setAttribute('data-target', famNum);
              document.getElementById('stat-val-houses').setAttribute('data-target', Math.round(famNum * 0.95));
            }
          }

          // Map active grievances count
          rawGrievances = grievances || [];
          document.getElementById('stat-val-grievances').setAttribute('data-target', rawGrievances.length);

          // Map household updates (survey rates)
          if (updates && updates.percentages) {
            householdStats.privateToilet = updates.percentages.privateToilet || 83;
            householdStats.tapWater = updates.percentages.tapWater || 81;
            householdStats.cleanEnergy = updates.percentages.cleanEnergy || 96;
            householdStats.ownHouse = updates.percentages.ownHouse || 86;
            householdStats.vehicle = updates.percentages.vehicle || 59;
          }

          // Trigger numerical animations, calculate score, load lists
          updateDataElements();
          applyTranslation(currentLanguage);
          triggerOverviewCounters();
        })
        .catch(err => {
          console.error("Error loading dashboard data:", err);
          showToast("❌ Error connecting to Panchayat data node.", "error");
          // Fallback to defaults
          updateDataElements();
          applyTranslation(currentLanguage);
          triggerOverviewCounters();
        });
    }

    // Refresh dynamic indicators, subscores, and rebuild charts
    function updateDataElements() {
      // Calculated factors of VDI: Avg of 6 parameters
      const vdiScore = Math.round((
        educationData.enrollment +
        householdStats.tapWater +
        householdStats.ownHouse +
        householdStats.privateToilet +
        householdStats.cleanEnergy +
        70 // health
      ) / 6);

      // Render VDI Circular Progress
      document.getElementById('vdi-score-display').textContent = vdiScore;
      const progressRing = document.getElementById('vdi-ring-progress');
      if (progressRing) {
        // Circumference is 2 * PI * 80 = 502.4
        const offset = 502.4 - (vdiScore / 100) * 502.4;
        progressRing.style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
      }

      // VDI Rating color coding
      const ratingDisplay = document.getElementById('vdi-rating-display');
      ratingDisplay.className = 'vdi-rating-badge';
      if (vdiScore >= 80) {
        ratingDisplay.textContent = currentLanguage === 'hi' ? 'उत्कृष्ट' : currentLanguage === 'te' ? 'అద్భుతం' : 'Excellent';
        ratingDisplay.classList.add('rating-excellent');
      } else if (vdiScore >= 50) {
        ratingDisplay.textContent = currentLanguage === 'hi' ? 'मध्यम' : currentLanguage === 'te' ? 'సాధారణం' : 'Moderate';
        ratingDisplay.classList.add('rating-moderate');
      } else {
        ratingDisplay.textContent = currentLanguage === 'hi' ? 'सुधार आवश्यक' : currentLanguage === 'te' ? 'మెరుగుపడాలి' : 'Needs Improvement';
        ratingDisplay.classList.add('rating-poor');
      }

      // Update Individual Subscores
      document.getElementById('fact-val-edu').textContent = educationData.enrollment + '%';
      document.getElementById('fact-fill-edu').style.width = educationData.enrollment + '%';

      document.getElementById('fact-val-water').textContent = householdStats.tapWater + '%';
      document.getElementById('fact-fill-water').style.width = householdStats.tapWater + '%';

      document.getElementById('fact-val-house').textContent = householdStats.ownHouse + '%';
      document.getElementById('fact-fill-house').style.width = householdStats.ownHouse + '%';

      document.getElementById('fact-val-san').textContent = householdStats.privateToilet + '%';
      document.getElementById('fact-fill-san').style.width = householdStats.privateToilet + '%';

      document.getElementById('fact-val-energy').textContent = householdStats.cleanEnergy + '%';
      document.getElementById('fact-fill-energy').style.width = householdStats.cleanEnergy + '%';

      document.getElementById('fact-val-health').textContent = '70%';
      document.getElementById('fact-fill-health').style.width = '70%';

      // Update Infrastructure progress bars
      document.getElementById('infra-val-water').textContent = householdStats.tapWater + '%';
      document.getElementById('infra-fill-water').style.width = householdStats.tapWater + '%';

      document.getElementById('infra-val-toilet').textContent = householdStats.privateToilet + '%';
      document.getElementById('infra-fill-toilet').style.width = householdStats.privateToilet + '%';

      document.getElementById('infra-val-lpg').textContent = householdStats.cleanEnergy + '%';
      document.getElementById('infra-fill-lpg').style.width = householdStats.cleanEnergy + '%';

      document.getElementById('infra-val-solar').textContent = householdStats.solar + '%';
      document.getElementById('infra-fill-solar').style.width = householdStats.solar + '%';

      // Solar 0% Warning check
      const solarWarning = document.getElementById('solar-warning-box');
      if (householdStats.solar === 0) {
        solarWarning.style.display = 'flex';
      } else {
        solarWarning.style.display = 'none';
      }

      // Literacy warning check (if rate < 70)
      const illiteracyWarning = document.getElementById('edu-illiteracy-warning');
      if (100 - (educationData.illiterate / 1256 * 100) < 70) {
        illiteracyWarning.style.display = 'flex';
      } else {
        illiteracyWarning.style.display = 'none';
      }

      // Refresh alerts list and charts
      renderAlertsAndInsights();
      renderAnnouncements();
      renderAllCharts();
    }

    // Animate numbers counting up on load
    function triggerOverviewCounters() {
      const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-count-num');
      counters.forEach(counter => {
        const target = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-target')) || 0;
        let count = 0;
        const speed = Math.max(1, Math.floor(target / 40));
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
          count += speed;
          if (count >= target) {
            counter.textContent = target.toLocaleString(currentLanguage === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'en-IN');
            clearInterval(timer);
          } else {
            counter.textContent = count.toLocaleString(currentLanguage === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'en-IN');
          }
        }, 20);
      });
    }

    // Render Smart Alerts & Insights
    function renderAlertsAndInsights() {
      const container = document.getElementById('alerts-container');
      if (!container) return;

      container.innerHTML = '';

      const alerts = [];

      // Solar check
      if (householdStats.solar === 0) {
        alerts.push({
          severity: 'critical',
          icon: '🚨',
          en: { title: "Solar Adoption Deficit", desc: "Solar coverage is currently 0%. Triggers structural carbon emissions and violates eco-resilience bylaws." },
          hi: { title: "सौर ऊर्जा गोद लेने में कमी", desc: "वर्तमान में सौर कवरेज ०% है। यह कार्बन उत्सर्जन को बढ़ावा देता है और पर्यावरण अनुकूल नियमों का उल्लंघन करता है।" },
          te: { title: "సౌర విద్యుత్ కొరత", desc: "సౌర విద్యుత్ వాడకం ప్రస్తుతం 0% గా ఉంది. ఇది పర్యావరణ పరిరక్షణ నిబంధనలకు విరుద్ధం." }
        });
      }

      // Toilet check
      if (householdStats.privateToilet < 100) {
        alerts.push({
          severity: 'warning',
          icon: '⚠️',
          en: { title: "Open Defecation Risk Remains", desc: `Sanitation coverage at ${householdStats.privateToilet}%. Target is 100% ODF+ rating. Immediate construction of public toilets requested.` },
          hi: { title: "खुले में शौच का जोखिम", desc: `स्वच्छता कवरेज ${householdStats.privateToilet}% पर है। लक्ष्य १००% ओडीएफ+ रेटिंग का है। सामुदायिक शौचालयों के निर्माण की आवश्यकता है।` },
          te: { title: "బహిరంగ మలవిసర్జన ముప్పు", desc: `శానిటేషన్ కవరేజీ ${householdStats.privateToilet}% వద్ద ఉంది. దీని లక్ష్యం 100% ODF+. మరిన్ని సామాజిక शौचालయాలు నిర్మించాల్సి ఉంది.` }
        });
      } else {
        alerts.push({
          severity: 'good',
          icon: '✅',
          en: { title: "ODF Status Maintained", desc: "100% private and public sanitation access audited across all wards. Excellent health and hygiene rating!" },
          hi: { title: "ओडीएफ स्तर बरकरार", desc: "सभी वार्डों में १००% निजी और सार्वजनिक स्वच्छता पहुंच का सफल ऑडिट। उत्कृष्ट स्वास्थ्य और स्वच्छता रेटिंग!" },
          te: { title: "ODF హోదా నిలకడ", desc: "అన్ని వార్డులలో 100% వ్యక్తిగత మరియు బహిరంగ శానిటేషన్ నిర్ధారించబడింది. అద్భుతమైన ఆరోగ్య రేటింగ్!" }
        });
      }

      // Water dependency check
      if (householdStats.tapWater < 80) {
        alerts.push({
          severity: 'warning',
          icon: '⚠️',
          en: { title: "High Dependency on Hand Pumps", desc: `Tap water grid connection is at ${householdStats.tapWater}%. Portions of Ward 3 and 4 depend on groundwater hand pumps during dry spells.` },
          hi: { title: "हैंडपंप पर अधिक निर्भरता", desc: `नल जल ग्रिड कनेक्शन ${householdStats.tapWater}% पर है। वार्ड ३ और ४ के कुछ हिस्से सूखे के दौरान भूजल हैंडपंपों पर निर्भर हैं।` },
          te: { title: "చేతి పంపులపై అధిక ఆధారం", desc: `తాగునీటి కనెక్షన్ కేవలం ${householdStats.tapWater}% వద్ద ఉంది. వేసవిలో వార్డు 3, 4 పరిధిలోని నివాసితులు చేతి పంపులపై ఆధారపడుతున్నారు.` }
        });
      }

      // Housing check
      if (householdStats.ownHouse > 80) {
        alerts.push({
          severity: 'good',
          icon: '✅',
          en: { title: "Pukka Housing Infrastructure Strong", desc: `Safe permanent housing coverage stands at ${householdStats.ownHouse}%. PM Awas Yojana registrations saturated.` },
          hi: { title: "पक्का आवास ढांचा मजबूत", desc: `सुरक्षित स्थायी आवास कवरेज ${householdStats.ownHouse}% पर है। प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना पंजीकरण संतृप्त हैं।` },
          te: { title: "పక్కా గృహ వసతి పటిష్టం", desc: `శాశ్వత నివాస గృహాల కవరేజీ ${householdStats.ownHouse}% కు చేరింది. పీఎం ఆవాస్ యోజన లబ్ధిదారుల నమోదు సంతృప్తికరంగా ఉంది.` }
        });
      }

      // LPG check
      if (householdStats.cleanEnergy > 90) {
        alerts.push({
          severity: 'good',
          icon: '✅',
          en: { title: "LPG Clean Fuel Coverage Excellent", desc: `Ujjwala scheme reaches ${householdStats.cleanEnergy}% of families, minimizing traditional fuelwood smoke hazard.` },
          hi: { title: "रसोई गैस स्वच्छ ईंधन कवरेज उत्कृष्ट", desc: `उज्ज्वला योजना ९६% परिवारों तक पहुंच चुकी है, जिससे पारंपरिक जलाऊ लकड़ी के धुएं का खतरा कम हो गया है।` },
          te: { title: "LPG క్లీన్ ఇంధనం అద్భుతం", desc: `ఉజ్వల పథకం ${householdStats.cleanEnergy}% కుటుంబాలకు చేరింది. పొయ్యి పొగ రహిత గ్రామంగా మారుతోంది.` }
        });
      }

      // Literacy rate check
      const literacyRate = Math.round(100 - (educationData.illiterate / 1256 * 100));
      if (literacyRate < 70) {
        alerts.push({
          severity: 'critical',
          icon: '🚨',
          en: { title: "Literacy Level Below Target", desc: `Overall literacy rate is currently ${literacyRate}%. Goal is 70% minimum. Recommended initiative: Night school workshops.` },
          hi: { title: "साक्षरता स्तर लक्ष्य से कम", desc: `कुल साक्षरता दर वर्तमान में ${literacyRate}% है। न्यूनतम लक्ष्य ७०% का है। रात्रि स्कूल कार्यशालाओं की सिफारिश की जाती है।` },
          te: { title: "అక్షరాస్యత రేటు తక్కువగా ఉంది", desc: `మొత్తం అక్షరాస్యత రేటు ప్రస్తుతం ${literacyRate}% గా ఉంది. కనీస లక్ష్యం 70%. రాత్రి బడులు ఏర్పాటు చేయాల్సిందిగా ప్రతిపాదన.` }
        });
      }

      // Render items
      alerts.forEach(item => {
        const langData = item[currentLanguage] || item.en;
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = `alert-card-item ${item.severity}`;
        card.innerHTML = `
          <span class="alert-item-icon">${item.icon}</span>
          <div class="alert-item-body">
            <span class="alert-item-title">${langData.title}</span>
            <span class="alert-item-desc">${langData.desc}</span>
          </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
      });
    }

    // Render notice board cards
    function renderAnnouncements() {
      const deck = document.getElementById('announcements-deck');
      if (!deck) return;

      deck.innerHTML = '';

      if (activeNotices.length === 0) {
        deck.innerHTML = '<p style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align:center; padding: 20px 0;">No active announcements listed from Panchayat.</p>';
        return;
      }

      activeNotices.slice(0, 4).forEach(item => {
        const title = item.title[currentLanguage] || item.title.en || '';
        const body = item.body[currentLanguage] || item.body.en || '';
        const category = item.category[currentLanguage] || item.category.en || '';
        const badge = item.badgeClass || 'info';

        const card = document.createElement('article');
        card.className = 'notice-deck-card';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="notice-deck-meta">
            <span>${item.date}</span>
            <span class="notice-badge badge-${badge}">${category}</span>
          </div>
          <h4>${title}</h4>
          <p>${body}</p>
        `;
        deck.appendChild(card);
      });
    }

    // Select digital twin asset detail panel populator
    function updateDigitalTwinPane(assetName) {
      const asset = digitalTwinAssets[assetName];
      if (!asset) return;

      const langData = asset[currentLanguage] || asset.en;

      document.getElementById('twin-pane-icon').textContent = getAssetIcon(assetName);
      document.getElementById('twin-pane-name').textContent = langData.name;
      document.getElementById('twin-pane-subtitle').textContent = langData.type;

      // Render key value grid
      const fieldsContainer = document.getElementById('twin-pane-fields');
      fieldsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      langData.fields.forEach(field => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'twin-pane-stat-row';
        row.innerHTML = `<span>${field.label}</span><span>${field.value}</span>`;
        fieldsContainer.appendChild(row);
      });

      document.getElementById('twin-pane-desc').textContent = langData.desc;
    }

    function getAssetIcon(assetName) {
      if (assetName === 'school') return '🏫';
      if (assetName === 'watertank') return '🚰';
      if (assetName === 'anganwadi') return '👶';
      if (assetName === 'temple') return '🛕';
      if (assetName === 'communityhall') return '🏛';
      return '🛣';
    }

    // Retrieve active colors based on theme preference
    function getThemeColors() {
      const isBanjara = document.body.classList.contains('banjara-active');
      if (isBanjara) {
        return {
          primary: '#4a0e17',    // Banjara Crimson
          secondary: '#d84315',  // Vibrant Banjara Orange
          accent: '#ffb300',     // Shell Gold
          hover: '#bf360c',
          backgrounds: ['#4a0e17', '#d84315', '#ffb300', '#ff7043', '#ffcc80']
        };
      } else {
        return {
          primary: '#0c1c12',    // Deep Forest Green
          secondary: '#2e7d32',  // Emerald Green
          accent: '#f5a623',     // Amber Gold
          hover: '#1b5e20',
          backgrounds: ['#0c1c12', '#2e7d32', '#f5a623', '#4caf50', '#a1887f']
        };
      }
    }

          datasets: [{

    // Display localized toasts helper
    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('alert-toast');
      const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-message');
      
      if (!toast || !toastText) return;
      
      toastText.textContent = message;
      
      if (type === 'error') {
        toast.style.borderLeftColor = 'var(--color-danger)';
      } else {
        toast.style.borderLeftColor = 'var(--color-success)';
      }
      
      toast.classList.add('active');
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('active');
      }, 3500);
    }
  </script>

  <!-- ==========================================
       CLIENT SIDE I18N ENGINE
       ========================================== -->
  <script>
    let currentLanguage = 'en';
    let originalTexts = {};
    let galleryItems = [];

    const translationDictionary = {
      hi: {
        '#gallery-main-heading': 'ग्राम मीडिया गैलरी',
        '#gallery-main-desc': 'सीतारामपुरम टांडा ग्राम पंचायत के ग्रामीण परिदृश्य, पारंपरिक लंबाडी कढ़ाई, पर्यावरण-अनुकूल आवासों और विकास कार्यों की दृश्य झलक।',
        '#tab-all': 'सभी मीडिया',
        '#tab-photos': 'तस्वीरें',
        '#tab-videos': 'वीडियो',
        '#btn-back-home': '← मुख्य पृष्ठ',
        '#footer-text-1': '© 2026 सीतारामपुरम टांडा पंचायत | ग्रामीण विकास विभाग',
        '#footer-text-2': 'आधिकारिक डिजिटल नागरिक नोड | आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य सरकार'
      },
      te: {
        '#gallery-main-heading': 'గ్రామ మీడియా గ్యాలరీ',
        '#gallery-main-desc': 'సీతారామపురం తండా గ్రామ పంచాయతీ యొక్క గ్రామీణ జీవనశైలి, సాంప్రదాయ లంబాడీ హస్తకళలు, ఇకో-గృహాలు మరియు అభివృద్ధి పనుల యొక్క దృశ్య రూపాంతరం.',
        '#tab-all': 'అన్ని మీడియా',
        '#tab-photos': 'ఫోటోలు',
        '#tab-videos': 'వీడియోలు',
        '#btn-back-home': '← హోమ్ పేజీ',
        '#footer-text-1': '© 2026 సీతారామపురం తండా పంచాయితీ | గ్రామీణాభివృద్ధి శాఖ',
        '#footer-text-2': 'అధికారిక డిజిటల్ సివిక్ నోడ్ | ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రభుత్వ రాష్ట్రం'
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      document.body.classList.add('ready');
      // Sync theme preference
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-theme');
      if (savedTheme === 'banjara' || (!savedTheme && document.body.classList.contains('banjara-active'))) {
        document.body.classList.add('banjara-active');
      } else if (savedTheme === 'eco') {
        document.body.classList.remove('banjara-active');
      }

      // Initialize translation original texts
      const selectors = Object.keys(translationDictionary.hi);
      selectors.forEach(sel => {
        const el = document.querySelector(sel);
        if (el) {
          originalTexts[sel] = el.innerHTML.trim();
        }
      });

      // Load saved language preference
      const savedLang = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-lang') || 'en';
      currentLanguage = savedLang;
      const select = document.getElementById('lang-select');
      if (select) {
        select.value = savedLang;
        select.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
          const lang = e.target.value;
          currentLanguage = lang;
          localStorage.setItem('panchayat-lang', lang);
          applyTranslation(lang);
          renderGalleryGrid();
          const toastMsg = lang === 'hi' ? '🇮🇳 भाषा बदलकर हिंदी कर दी गई है।' : lang === 'te' ? '🇮🇳 భాష తెలుగులోకి మార్చబడింది.' : '🇬🇧 Language switched to English.';
          showToast(toastMsg, 'success');
        });
      }

      // Fetch dynamic gallery and initialize
      const localConfigStr = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-main-page-config');
      if (localConfigStr) {
        try {
          const localConfig = JSON.parse(localConfigStr);
          galleryItems = localConfig.gallery || [];
          applyTranslation(currentLanguage);
          renderGalleryGrid();
          initGalleryTabs();
          initLightbox();
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Error parsing local config in gallery:", e);
        }
      }

      fetch('/api/main-page-config')
        .then(res => {
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Network response not ok');
          return res.json();
        })
        .then(config => {
          let mergedGallery = config.gallery || [];
          if (localConfigStr) {
            try {
              const localConfig = JSON.parse(localConfigStr);
              if (localConfig.gallery) {
                mergedGallery = localConfig.gallery;
              }
            } catch (e) {
              console.error("Error merging local gallery config:", e);
            }
          }
          galleryItems = mergedGallery;
          applyTranslation(currentLanguage);
          renderGalleryGrid();
          initGalleryTabs();
          initLightbox();
        })
        .catch(err => {
          console.error("Error loading gallery data:", err);
          if (!localConfigStr) {
            showToast("❌ Failed to load gallery items from server.", "error");
          }
        });
    });

    function applyTranslation(lang) {
      currentLanguage = lang;
      document.body.classList.remove('lang-en', 'lang-hi', 'lang-te');
      document.body.classList.add('lang-' + lang);
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', lang);

      const selectors = Object.keys(translationDictionary.hi);
      selectors.forEach(sel => {
        const el = document.querySelector(sel);
        if (!el) return;

        if (lang === 'en') {
          if (originalTexts[sel]) {
            el.innerHTML = originalTexts[sel];
          }
        } else {
          if (translationDictionary[lang] && translationDictionary[lang][sel]) {
            el.innerHTML = translationDictionary[lang][sel];
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function renderGalleryGrid() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('media-grid');
      if (!grid) return;
      grid.innerHTML = '';

      const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';

      if (galleryItems.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align:center; color:var(--color-text-muted); padding: 40px 0;">No media items configured. Manage them in Admin Panel.</p>';
        return;
      }

      galleryItems.forEach((item, index) => {
        const title = item.title[lang] || item.title.en || '';
        const desc = item.desc[lang] || item.desc.en || '';
        const badge = item.badge[lang] || item.badge.en || '';
        const caption = item.caption[lang] || item.caption.en || '';
        const thumbnail = item.thumbnail || (item.type === 'video' ? 'assets/housing_layout.png' : item.src);

        const card = document.createElement('article');
        card.className = 'media-card';
        card.setAttribute('data-type', item.type);
        card.setAttribute('data-src', item.src);
        card.setAttribute('data-caption', caption);
        card.setAttribute('data-index', index);

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="media-preview-container">
            <span class="media-badge">${badge}</span>
            <img src="${thumbnail}" alt="${title}" loading="lazy" style="${item.type === 'video' ? 'filter: brightness(0.6);' : ''}">
            ${item.type === 'video' ? `
              <div class="video-play-overlay">
                <div class="play-btn-circle">▶</div>
              </div>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="media-details">
            <h3>${title}</h3>
            <p>${desc}</p>
          </div>
        `;
        grid.appendChild(card);
      });

      filterGalleryGrid();
    }

    function filterGalleryGrid() {
      const activeTabBtn = document.querySelector('.gallery-tab-btn.active');
      if (!activeTabBtn) return;
      const category = activeTabBtn.getAttribute('data-tab');
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.media-card');
      cards.forEach(card => {
        const type = card.getAttribute('data-type');
        if (category === 'all' || type === category) {
          card.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    }

    function initGalleryTabs() {
      const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-tab-btn');
      tabs.forEach(tab => {
        const newTab = tab.cloneNode(true);
        tab.parentNode.replaceChild(newTab, tab);
        newTab.addEventListener('click', () => {
          document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-tab-btn').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
          newTab.classList.add('active');
          filterGalleryGrid();
        });
      });
    }

    function initLightbox() {
      const viewer = document.getElementById('lightbox-viewer');
      const container = document.getElementById('lightbox-media-container');
      const caption = document.getElementById('lightbox-caption-text');
      const closeBtn = document.getElementById('lightbox-close-btn');
      const grid = document.getElementById('media-grid');
      if (!grid) return;

      const newGrid = grid.cloneNode(false);
      while(grid.firstChild) {
        newGrid.appendChild(grid.firstChild);
      }
      grid.parentNode.replaceChild(newGrid, grid);

      newGrid.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const card = e.target.closest('.media-card');
        if (!card) return;

        const type = card.getAttribute('data-type');
        const src = card.getAttribute('data-src');
        const cap = card.getAttribute('data-caption');

        container.innerHTML = '';

        if (type === 'photo') {
          const img = document.createElement('img');
          img.src = src;
          img.className = 'lightbox-media';
          img.alt = 'Enlarged View';
          container.appendChild(img);
        } else if (type === 'video') {
          const video = document.createElement('video');
          video.src = src;
          video.className = 'lightbox-media';
          video.controls = true;
          video.autoplay = true;
          video.style.outline = 'none';
          container.appendChild(video);
        }

        caption.textContent = cap;
        viewer.classList.add('active');
      });

      const closeLightbox = () => {
        viewer.classList.remove('active');
        container.innerHTML = '';
      };

      const newCloseBtn = closeBtn.cloneNode(true);
      closeBtn.parentNode.replaceChild(newCloseBtn, closeBtn);
      newCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);

      const newViewer = viewer.cloneNode(true);
      viewer.parentNode.replaceChild(newViewer, viewer);
      newViewer.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === newViewer || e.target.id === 'lightbox-close-btn') closeLightbox();
      });

      document.removeEventListener('keydown', escapeKeyHandler);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', escapeKeyHandler);

      function escapeKeyHandler(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          newViewer.classList.remove('active');
          document.getElementById('lightbox-media-container').innerHTML = '';
        }
      }
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('alert-toast');
      const msgText = document.getElementById('toast-message');
      if (!toast || !msgText) return;

      msgText.textContent = message;
      toast.classList.add('active');

      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('active');
      }, 3000);
    }
  </script>
</html>

    <!-- ==========================================
         ABOUT SEETHARAMPURAM THANDA & VILLAGE PROFILE
         ========================================== -->
    <section class="section-padding about-section" id="about" aria-labelledby="about-heading">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="section-header">
          <span class="section-icon" aria-hidden="true">🏛️</span>
          <p class="section-subtitle" id="about-section-subtitle">ABOUT THE VILLAGE & TRIBAL PROFILE</p>
          <h2 class="section-title" id="about-heading">Seetharampuram Thanda History & Demographics</h2>
          <p class="section-desc" id="about-section-desc">Explore the unique history, cultural heritage, geographical details, and comprehensive profile metrics of our Gram Panchayat.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="about-profile-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr; gap: 32px; margin-top: 40px;">
          <!-- Left: History & Details -->
          <div class="about-history-card" style="background: var(--color-bg-card); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); padding: 32px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);">
            <h3 style="font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-primary); margin-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); padding-bottom: 8px;" id="about-history-title">Our Heritage & Settlement</h3>
            <p style="font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 16px;" id="about-history-p1">
              <strong>History:</strong> Seetharampuram Thanda was settled several generations ago by families from the Banjara (Lambadi) tribe who migrated to the rocky terrains of Andhra Pradesh. Starting as a temporary settlement (Thanda), it grew into a permanent resilient agricultural hub.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 16px;" id="about-history-p2">
              <strong>Naming Origin:</strong> The name "Seetharampuram" is derived from the historic Seetharama Temple located on the outskirts of the hills, where the community continues to offer prayers. The suffix "Thanda" is the traditional term for a Banjara settlement.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 16px;" id="about-history-p3">
              <strong>Tribal Identity & Culture:</strong> The village is predominantly inhabited by the Lambadi community, preserving ancestral customs, traditional multi-colored embroidered dresses featuring mirrors and cowrie shells, and dancing to Teej festival folk songs.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 0;" id="about-history-p4">
              <strong>Geography & Language:</strong> Nestled in the Palnadu district of Andhra Pradesh, our residents speak <em>Gor Boli</em> (the native Lambadi dialect) internally, and Telugu or Hindi for external trade. The nearby towns are Macherla (15 km) and Nagarjuna Sagar (28 km).
            </p>
          </div>

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      // Apply theme
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-theme');
      document.body.classList.add('ready');
      if (savedTheme === 'banjara' || (!savedTheme && document.body.classList.contains('banjara-active'))) {
        document.body.classList.add('banjara-active');
      } else if (savedTheme === 'eco') {
        document.body.classList.remove('banjara-active');
      }

      // Initialize language selector
      const select = document.getElementById('lang-select');
      const savedLang = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-lang') || 'en';
      select.value = savedLang;
      currentLanguage = savedLang;

      // Render Page Content initially
      renderPillarContent(pillarType, savedLang);

      // Listen for language change
      select.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        const lang = e.target.value;
        currentLanguage = lang;
        localStorage.setItem('panchayat-lang', lang);
        
        renderPillarContent(pillarType, lang);

        const toastMsg = lang === 'hi' ? '🇮🇳 भाषा बदलकर हिंदी कर दी गई है।' : lang === 'te' ? '🇮🇳 భాష తెలుగులోకి మార్చబడింది.' : '🇬🇧 Language switched to English.';
        showToast(toastMsg, 'success');
      });

      // Modal trigger setup
      const openModalBtn = document.getElementById('btn-trigger-facility-update');
      const closeModalBtn = document.getElementById('btn-close-facility-modal');
      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-household-update');
      const form = document.getElementById('household-update-form');

      if (openModalBtn && modal) {
        openModalBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          modal.classList.add('active');
          document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        });
      }

      const closeFacilityModal = () => {
        if (modal) {
          modal.classList.remove('active');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
      };

      if (closeModalBtn) {
        closeModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeFacilityModal);
      }

      if (modal) {
        modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (e.target === modal) {
            closeFacilityModal();
          }
        });
      }

      // Initial fetch of household updates
      fetchHouseholdUpdates();

      if (form) {
        form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();

          const householdId = document.getElementById('update-household-id').value.trim();
          const privateToilet = document.getElementById('chk-toilet').checked;
          const vehicle = document.getElementById('chk-vehicle').checked;
          const tapWater = document.getElementById('chk-water').checked;
          const cleanEnergy = document.getElementById('chk-energy').checked;
          const ownHouse = document.getElementById('chk-house').checked;
          const aadhaar = document.getElementById('chk-aadhaar').checked;

          fetch('/api/household-updates', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              householdId,
              privateToilet,
              vehicle,
              tapWater,
              cleanEnergy,
              ownHouse,
              aadhaar
            })
          })
          .then(res => {
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('API failed');
            return res.json();
          })
          .then(data => {
            const uiTrans = translationUI[currentLanguage] || translationUI['en'];
            const toastMsg = uiTrans.toastSuccess || '✅ Household details updated successfully!';
            showToast(toastMsg, 'success');
            
            form.reset();
            closeFacilityModal();
            renderHouseholdChart(data);
          })
          .catch(err => {
            console.error('Error updating household details:', err);
            const uiTrans = translationUI[currentLanguage] || translationUI['en'];
            const errorMsg = uiTrans.toastError || '❌ Error updating household details. Please try again.';
            showToast(errorMsg, 'error');
          });
        });
      }

      // Initialize Village Dashboard
      initVillageDashboard();

      const openDashboardBtn = document.getElementById('nav-link-dashboard-pillars');
      const closeDashboardBtn = document.querySelector('#modal-village-dashboard .modal-close-btn');
      const dashboardModal = document.getElementById('modal-village-dashboard');

      if (openDashboardBtn && dashboardModal) {
        openDashboardBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dashboardModal.classList.add('active');
          document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
          if (mainPageConfig) {
            renderVillageDashboardData();
          } else {
            fetch('/api/main-page-config')
              .then(res => res.json())
              .then(config => {
                mainPageConfig = config;
                renderVillageDashboardData();
              })
              .catch(err => console.error('Error loading config:', err));
          }
        });
      }

      if (closeDashboardBtn && dashboardModal) {
        closeDashboardBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          dashboardModal.classList.remove('active');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
        });
      }

      if (dashboardModal) {
        dashboardModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (e.target === dashboardModal) {
            dashboardModal.classList.remove('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
          }
        });
      }

      // Check URL parameter to auto-open dashboard modal
      const openModalParam = params.get('openModal');
      if (openModalParam === 'modal-village-dashboard' && dashboardModal) {
        dashboardModal.classList.add('active');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        fetch('/api/main-page-config')
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(config => {
            mainPageConfig = config;
            renderVillageDashboardData();
          })
          .catch(err => console.error('Error loading config:', err));
      }

      // Initialize Voice Assistant
      initVoiceAssistant();
    });

    /* ==========================================
       AI VOICE ASSISTANT WIDGET LOGIC
       ========================================== */
    function initVoiceAssistant() {
      const fab = document.getElementById('voice-assistant-fab');
      const card = document.getElementById('voice-assistant-card');
      const closeBtn = document.getElementById('voice-card-close-btn');
      const statusEl = document.getElementById('voice-status');
      const transcriptEl = document.getElementById('voice-transcript');
      const suggestionsEl = document.getElementById('voice-suggestions');
      const suggestTitleEl = document.getElementById('voice-suggest-title');
      const cardTitleEl = document.getElementById('voice-card-title');
      const warningEl = document.getElementById('voice-ip-warning');
      const textInput = document.getElementById('voice-text-input');
      const textSubmit = document.getElementById('voice-text-submit');

      if (!fab || !card) return;

      const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
      let recognition = null;
      let isListening = false;

      const voiceConfigs = {
        en: {
          title: "AI Voice Assistant",
          statusClick: "Click mic to start",
          statusListening: "Listening... Speak now",
          statusError: "Error. Click mic to retry",
          statusRecognized: "Processing...",
          suggestTitle: "Suggestions",
          suggestPlaceholder: "Say a command like \"Go home\"...",
          chips: ["Go home", "Go to health", "Go to water", "Banjara theme", "Open welfare", "Open dashboard"],
          unsupported: "⚠️ Voice Recognition is not supported in this browser.",
          noMatch: "Command not recognized. Try saying a suggestion.",
          textPlaceholder: "Or type a command here...",
          textSubmit: "Send",
          warningIp: "🎙️ Mic disabled on HTTP IP. Type commands below, or go to chrome://flags/#unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure and add http://10.253.91.42:8000"
        },
        hi: {
          title: "एआई वॉयस असिस्टेंट",
          statusClick: "शुरू करने के लिए माइक दबाएं",
          statusListening: "सुन रहा हूँ... अब बोलें",
          statusError: "त्रुटि। पुनः प्रयास करने के लिए माइक दबाएं",
          statusRecognized: "संसाधित किया जा रहा है...",
          suggestTitle: "सुझाव",
          suggestPlaceholder: "बोलें: \"मुख्य पृष्ठ\" या \"स्वास्थ्य पर जाएं\"...",
          chips: ["मुख्य पृष्ठ", "स्वास्थ्य पर जाएं", "पानी पर जाएं", "थीम बदलें", "कल्याण योजना", "डैशबोर्ड खोलें"],
          unsupported: "⚠️ इस ब्राउज़र में वॉयस रिकग्निशन समर्थित नहीं है।",
          noMatch: "आदेश समझ नहीं आया। कोई सुझाव बोलकर देखें।",
          textPlaceholder: "या यहाँ एक आदेश टाइप करें...",
          textSubmit: "भेजें",
          warningIp: "🎙️ HTTP आईपी पर माइक अक्षम है। नीचे आदेश टाइप करें, या क्रोम फ़्लैग्स में http://10.253.91.42:8000 जोड़ें"
        },
        te: {
          title: "AI వాయిస్ అసిస్టెంట్",
          statusClick: "ప్రారంభించడానికి మైక్ నొక్కండి",
          statusListening: "వింటున్నాను... ఇప్పుడు మాట్లాడండి",
          statusError: "లోపం. మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించడానికి మైక్ నొక్కండి",
          statusRecognized: "ప్రాసెస్ చేయబడుతోంది...",
          suggestTitle: "సూచనలు",
          suggestPlaceholder: "చెప్పండి: \"హోమ్ పేజీ\" లేదా \"ఆరోగ్యం\"...",
          chips: ["హోమ్ పేజీ", "ఆరోగ్యం", "నీరు", "థీమ్ మార్చు", "పథకాలు", "డ్యాష్‌బోర్డ్"],
          unsupported: "⚠️ ఈ బ్రౌజర్‌లో వాయిస్ రికగ్నిషన్ సపోర్ట్ లేదు.",
          noMatch: "ఆదేశం గుర్తించబడలేదు. సూచనలలో ఒకదాన్ని చెప్పండి.",
          textPlaceholder: "లేదా ఇక్కడ టైప్ చేయండి...",
          textSubmit: "పంపు",
          warningIp: "🎙️ HTTP IP లో మైక్ నిలిపివేయబడింది. కింద టైప్ చేయండి, లేదా క్రోమ్ ఫ్లాగ్స్‌లో http://10.253.91.42:8000 జోడించండి"
        }
      };

      const handleTextSubmit = () => {
        if (textInput) {
          const val = textInput.value.trim();
          if (val) {
            if (isListening) {
              stopListening();
            }
            transcriptEl.textContent = `"${val}"`;
            processCommand(val);
            textInput.value = '';
          }
        }
      };

      if (textSubmit) {
        textSubmit.addEventListener('click', handleTextSubmit);
      }
      if (textInput) {
        textInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            handleTextSubmit();
          }
        });
      }

      function updateCardTexts() {
        const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
        const cfg = voiceConfigs[lang] || voiceConfigs['en'];
        
        cardTitleEl.textContent = cfg.title;
        suggestTitleEl.textContent = cfg.suggestTitle;
        if (!isListening) {
          statusEl.textContent = cfg.statusClick;
          transcriptEl.textContent = cfg.suggestPlaceholder;
        }

        const isSecure = window.isSecureContext || window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1';
        if (warningEl) {
          if (!isSecure) {
            warningEl.style.display = 'block';
            warningEl.textContent = cfg.warningIp;
          } else {
            warningEl.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }

        if (textInput) {
          textInput.placeholder = cfg.textPlaceholder;
        }
        if (textSubmit) {
          textSubmit.textContent = cfg.textSubmit;
        }

        suggestionsEl.innerHTML = '';
        cfg.chips.forEach(chipText => {
          const chip = document.createElement('button');
          chip.className = 'voice-suggestion-chip';
          chip.textContent = chipText;
          chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (isListening) {
              stopListening();
            }
            transcriptEl.textContent = `"${chipText}"`;
            processCommand(chipText);
          });
          suggestionsEl.appendChild(chip);
        });
      }

      function speakConfirmation(text) {
        if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
          window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
          const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
          const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
          if (lang === 'hi') utterance.lang = 'hi-IN';
          else if (lang === 'te') utterance.lang = 'te-IN';
          else utterance.lang = 'en-IN';
          window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
        }
      }

      function startListening() {
        if (!SpeechRecognition) {
          showToast(voiceConfigs[currentLanguage || 'en'].unsupported, 'warning');
          return;
        }

        if (!recognition) {
          recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
          recognition.continuous = false;
          recognition.interimResults = false;

          recognition.onstart = () => {
            isListening = true;
            fab.classList.add('listening');
            card.classList.add('listening');
            const cfg = voiceConfigs[currentLanguage || 'en'] || voiceConfigs['en'];
            statusEl.textContent = cfg.statusListening;
            transcriptEl.textContent = "...";
          };

          recognition.onresult = (event) => {
            const resultText = event.results[0][0].transcript;
            transcriptEl.textContent = `"${resultText}"`;
            const cfg = voiceConfigs[currentLanguage || 'en'] || voiceConfigs['en'];
            statusEl.textContent = cfg.statusRecognized;
            processCommand(resultText);
          };

          recognition.onerror = (event) => {
            console.error('Speech recognition error:', event.error);
            const cfg = voiceConfigs[currentLanguage || 'en'] || voiceConfigs['en'];
            statusEl.textContent = cfg.statusError;
            stopListening();
          };

          recognition.onend = () => {
            stopListening();
          };
        }

        const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
        if (lang === 'hi') {
          recognition.lang = 'hi-IN';
        } else if (lang === 'te') {
          recognition.lang = 'te-IN';
        } else {
          recognition.lang = 'en-IN';
        }

        try {
          recognition.start();
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      }

      function stopListening() {
        isListening = false;
        fab.classList.remove('listening');
        card.classList.remove('listening');
        const cfg = voiceConfigs[currentLanguage || 'en'] || voiceConfigs['en'];
        if (statusEl.textContent === cfg.statusListening) {
          statusEl.textContent = cfg.statusClick;
        }
        if (recognition) {
          try {
            recognition.stop();
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }

      fab.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const isActive = card.classList.contains('active');
        if (isActive) {
          if (isListening) {
            stopListening();
          } else {
            startListening();
          }
        } else {
          card.classList.add('active');
          card.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
          updateCardTexts();
          startListening();
        }
      });

      closeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        card.classList.remove('active');
        card.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        stopListening();
      });

      const select = document.getElementById('lang-select');
      if (select) {
        select.addEventListener('change', () => {
          updateCardTexts();
        });
      }

                renderVillageDashboardData();

      function executeAction(actionCallback, responses) {
        const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
        const responseText = responses[lang] || responses['en'];
        statusEl.textContent = responseText;
        speakConfirmation(responseText);
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          actionCallback();
          card.classList.remove('active');
        }, 1000);
      }

      function executePillarSwitch(targetType, responses) {
        const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
        const responseText = responses[lang] || responses['en'];
        statusEl.textContent = responseText;
        speakConfirmation(responseText);

        setTimeout(() => {
          pillarType = targetType;
          window.history.pushState({}, '', `pillars.html?type=${targetType}`);
          renderPillarContent(targetType, currentLanguage);
          fetchHouseholdUpdates();
          updateCardTexts();
          card.classList.remove('active');
        }, 1000);
      }

      function executeLanguageChange(targetLang, responses) {
        const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
        const responseText = responses[lang] || responses['en'];
        statusEl.textContent = responseText;
        speakConfirmation(responseText);

        setTimeout(() => {
          const select = document.getElementById('lang-select');
          if (select) {
            select.value = targetLang;
            select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
            updateCardTexts();
          }
          card.classList.remove('active');
        }, 1000);
      }

      function executeNavigation(url, responses) {
        const lang = currentLanguage || 'en';
        const responseText = responses[lang] || responses['en'];
        statusEl.textContent = responseText;
        speakConfirmation(responseText);

        setTimeout(() => {
          window.location.href = url;
        }, 1000);
      }

      updateCardTexts();
    }

    function triggerGenderBarAnimation() {
      const bar = document.getElementById('vd-gender-bar');
      if (bar) {
        bar.style.width = '0%';
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (mainPageConfig && mainPageConfig.villageDashboard && mainPageConfig.villageDashboard.statistics) {
            const st = mainPageConfig.villageDashboard.statistics;
            const male = parseInt((st.malePopulation || '').replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
            const female = parseInt((st.femalePopulation || '').replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
            const total = male + female;
            if (total > 0) {
              const malePct = Math.round((male / total) * 100);
              bar.style.width = `${malePct}%`;
            }
          }
        }, 100);
      }
    }

    function initVillageDashboard() {
      const tabs = ['overview', 'statistics', 'education', 'schemes', 'announcements'];
      tabs.forEach(tabName => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`vd-tab-${tabName}`);
        if (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            tabs.forEach(t => {
              const b = document.getElementById(`vd-tab-${t}`);
              if (b) {
                b.classList.remove('active');
                b.style.color = 'var(--color-text-muted)';
                b.style.borderLeftColor = 'transparent';
              }
              const s = document.getElementById(`vd-sec-${t}`);
              if (s) s.style.display = 'none';
            });

            btn.classList.add('active');
            btn.style.color = 'var(--color-primary)';
            btn.style.borderLeftColor = 'var(--color-primary)';
            
            const sec = document.getElementById(`vd-sec-${tabName}`);
            if (sec) sec.style.display = 'block';

            if (tabName === 'statistics') {
              triggerGenderBarAnimation();
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    function renderVillageDashboardData() {
      if (!mainPageConfig || !mainPageConfig.villageDashboard) return;
      const villageConfig = mainPageConfig.villageDashboard;
      const ov = villageConfig.overview || {};
      const st = villageConfig.statistics || {};
      const edu = villageConfig.education || {};
      const sch = villageConfig.schemes || {};
      const ann = villageConfig.announcements || {};

      const setEl = (id, val) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el && val !== undefined) el.textContent = val;
      };

      // Overview Cards
      setEl('vd-total-population', ov.totalPopulation);
      setEl('vd-total-families',   ov.totalFamilies);
      setEl('vd-total-houses',     ov.totalHouses);
      setEl('vd-total-farmers',    ov.totalFarmers);
      setEl('vd-total-students',   ov.totalStudents);
      setEl('vd-total-employees',  ov.totalEmployees);
      setEl('vd-sarpanch-name',    ov.sarpanchName);
      setEl('vd-number-of-wards',  ov.numberOfWards);

      // Statistics
      setEl('vd-male-pop',        st.malePopulation);
      setEl('vd-female-pop',      st.femalePopulation);
      setEl('vd-literacy-rate',   st.literacyRate);
      setEl('vd-employment-rate', st.employmentRate);
      setEl('vd-agri-area',       st.agricultureArea);
      setEl('vd-irrigated-land',  st.irrigatedLand);
      setEl('vd-main-crops',      st.mainCrops);
      setEl('vd-farmers-subsidy', st.farmersWithSubsidy);

      // Education
      setEl('vd-num-schools',      edu.numberOfSchools);
      setEl('vd-edu-students',     edu.totalStudents);
      setEl('vd-edu-scholarships', edu.scholarshipsProvided);

      // Schemes
      setEl('vd-scheme-beneficiaries', sch.beneficiaries);
      setEl('vd-scheme-active',        sch.activeSchemes);
      setEl('vd-scheme-pending',       sch.pendingApplications);

      // Announcements
      setEl('vd-announce-event',   ann.upcomingEvents);
      setEl('vd-announce-meeting', ann.gramSabhaMeetings);
      setEl('vd-announce-notif',   ann.governmentNotifications);

      // Gender bar calculation
      const male = parseInt((st.malePopulation || '').replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
      const female = parseInt((st.femalePopulation || '').replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
      const total = male + female;
      if (total > 0) {
        const malePct = Math.round((male / total) * 100);
        const femalePct = 100 - malePct;
        const bar = document.getElementById('vd-gender-bar');
        if (bar) bar.style.width = `${malePct}%`;
        setEl('vd-male-pct',   `${malePct}% Male`);
        setEl('vd-female-pct', `${femalePct}% Female`);
      }
    }

    function renderPillarContent(type, lang) {

      document.getElementById('household-modal-desc').textContent = uiTrans.modalDesc || "Self-report your household's upgraded amenities to help update the Gram Panchayat dataset.";

        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.style.borderBottom = `1px solid ${theme.bg}`;
        if (idx % 2 === 1) {
          tr.style.backgroundColor = theme.cardBg;
        }

        let code = '';
        let name = m;
        if (m.includes(':')) {
          const parts = m.split(':');
          code = parts[0].trim();
          name = parts.slice(1).join(':').trim();
        }

        // Col 1: Code
        const tdCode = document.createElement('td');
        tdCode.style.padding = '10px 12px';

    function normalizeCode(str) {
      return str.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '').trim();
    }

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('alert-toast');
      const msgText = document.getElementById('toast-message');
      if (!toast || !msgText) return;

      msgText.textContent = message;
      
      // Update border color based on type
      if (type === 'success') {
        toast.style.borderLeft = '5px solid var(--color-success)';
      } else if (type === 'warning') {
        toast.style.borderLeft = '5px solid #f39c12'; // Warning orange
      } else if (type === 'danger' || type === 'error') {
        toast.style.borderLeft = '5px solid #e74c3c'; // Error red
      } else {
        toast.style.borderLeft = '5px solid var(--color-primary)';
      }

      toast.classList.add('active');

      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('active');
      }, 3000);
    }

    function fetchHouseholdUpdates() {
      fetch('/api/household-updates')
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch');
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(data => {
        renderHouseholdChart(data);
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error fetching updates:', err);
      });
    }

    function renderHouseholdChart(data) {
      const percentages = data.percentages || { privateToilet: 80, vehicle: 60, tapWater: 94, cleanEnergy: 50, ownHouse: 82 };
      
      const valToilet = document.getElementById('val-toilet');
      if (valToilet) valToilet.textContent = `${percentages.privateToilet}%`;
      const valVehicle = document.getElementById('val-vehicle');
      if (valVehicle) valVehicle.textContent = `${percentages.vehicle}%`;
      const valWater = document.getElementById('val-water');
      if (valWater) valWater.textContent = `${percentages.tapWater}%`;
      const valEnergy = document.getElementById('val-energy');
      if (valEnergy) valEnergy.textContent = `${percentages.cleanEnergy}%`;
      const valHouse = document.getElementById('val-house');
      if (valHouse) valHouse.textContent = `${percentages.ownHouse}%`;
      const valAadhaar = document.getElementById('val-aadhaar');
      if (valAadhaar) valAadhaar.textContent = `${percentages.aadhaar || 0}%`;

      const barToilet = document.getElementById('bar-toilet');
      if (barToilet) barToilet.style.width = `${percentages.privateToilet}%`;
      const barVehicle = document.getElementById('bar-vehicle');
      if (barVehicle) barVehicle.style.width = `${percentages.vehicle}%`;
      const barWater = document.getElementById('bar-water');
      if (barWater) barWater.style.width = `${percentages.tapWater}%`;
      const barEnergy = document.getElementById('bar-energy');
      if (barEnergy) barEnergy.style.width = `${percentages.cleanEnergy}%`;
      const barHouse = document.getElementById('bar-house');
      if (barHouse) barHouse.style.width = `${percentages.ownHouse}%`;
      const barAadhaar = document.getElementById('bar-aadhaar');
      if (barAadhaar) barAadhaar.style.width = `${percentages.aadhaar || 0}%`;

      const badge = document.getElementById('household-chart-badge');
      if (badge) {
        const totalCount = data.totalUpdates || 50;
        const uiTrans = translationUI[currentLanguage] || translationUI['en'];
        const selfReportedText = uiTrans.selfReported || "Self-Reported";
        badge.textContent = `${selfReportedText} (${totalCount})`;
      }
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    const userId = sessionStorage.getItem('panchayat-userId');

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      document.body.classList.add('ready');
      // Sync theme preference
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('panchayat-theme');
      if (savedTheme === 'banjara' || (!savedTheme && document.body.classList.contains('banjara-active'))) {
        document.body.classList.add('banjara-active');
      } else if (savedTheme === 'eco') {
        document.body.classList.remove('banjara-active');
      }

      if (userId) {
        loadCitizenProfile(userId);
      } else {
        window.location.replace('/');
      }
    });

    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('alert-toast');
      const msgText = document.getElementById('toast-message');
      
      if (!toast || !msgText) return;
      
      toast.className = 'alert-popup';
      toast.classList.add(type);
      msgText.textContent = message;
      
      toast.classList.add('active');
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('active');
      }, 3500);
    }

    function loadCitizenProfile(cardId) {
      // 1. Fetch Ration Details
      fetch(`/api/ration?id=${encodeURIComponent(cardId)}`)
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Ration card not found');
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(card => {
        document.getElementById('citizen-name').textContent = card.owner;
        document.getElementById('report-citizen-name').value = card.owner;
        document.getElementById('citizen-card-id').textContent = card.id;
        document.getElementById('citizen-card-type').textContent = card.type;
        document.getElementById('citizen-fps-shop').textContent = `Shop No. ${card.shop}`;
        document.getElementById('citizen-members').textContent = card.members;
        
        document.getElementById('quota-rice').textContent = card.rice;
        document.getElementById('quota-wheat').textContent = card.wheat;
        document.getElementById('quota-kerosene').textContent = card.kerosene;

        // Load grievances matching the citizen's name
        loadCitizenGrievances(card.owner);
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error(err);
        showToast('❌ Failed to fetch ration profile records.', 'error');
      });
    }

    function loadCitizenGrievances(ownerName) {
      const container = document.getElementById('personal-grievances-container');
      
      fetch('/api/grievances')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(list => {
        // Filter list by ownerName (case insensitive check)
        const myTickets = list.filter(t => t.name.toLowerCase().trim() === ownerName.toLowerCase().trim());
        
        container.innerHTML = '';
        if (myTickets.length === 0) {
          container.innerHTML = `
            <div style="text-align: center; color: var(--color-text-muted); padding: 30px;">
              <p style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">No filed concerns found.</p>
              <p style="font-size:0.75rem;">If you have a civic issue, please log a complaint from the homepage.</p>
            </div>
          `;
          return;
        }

        myTickets.forEach(ticket => {
          const badgeClass = ticket.status === 'Resolved' ? 'badge-resolved' : ticket.status === 'In Progress' ? 'badge-inprogress' : 'badge-submitted';
          
          const card = document.createElement('div');
          card.className = 'personal-grievance-item';
          
          // History mapping
          let historyStepsHTML = '';
          ticket.history.forEach(step => {
            historyStepsHTML += `
              <div class="timeline-step">
                <strong>${step.status}</strong> (${step.time})<br/>
                <span style="font-size:0.75rem; color: var(--color-text-muted);">${step.detail}</span>
              </div>
            `;
          });

          card.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border); padding-bottom:8px; margin-bottom:12px;">
              <strong>ID: ${ticket.id}</strong>
              <span class="badge-status ${badgeClass}">${ticket.status}</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:0.85rem; line-height:1.4;">
              <p><strong>Category:</strong> ${ticket.category.toUpperCase()}</p>
              <p><strong>Details:</strong> ${ticket.desc}</p>
              <p><strong>Assigned Officer:</strong> ${ticket.assignedTo}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="timeline-container">
              <h5 style="font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-primary); margin:0;">Resolution History Timeline</h5>
              ${historyStepsHTML}
            </div>
          `;
          container.appendChild(card);
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error fetching grievances:', err);
        container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--color-danger); text-align:center;">Failed to connect to grievances database.</p>';
      });
    }

    function submitReportedIssue(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      
      const name = document.getElementById('report-citizen-name').value;
      const phone = document.getElementById('report-phone').value.trim();
      const category = document.getElementById('report-category').value;
      const desc = document.getElementById('report-desc').value.trim();

      fetch('/api/grievances', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, phone, category, desc })
      })
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('API failure');
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(newTicket => {
        showToast(`✓ Issue submitted successfully! ID: ${newTicket.id}`, 'success');
        document.getElementById('report-phone').value = '';
        document.getElementById('report-desc').value = '';
        
        // Reload grievances list for this citizen
        loadCitizenGrievances(name);
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error reporting issue:', err);
        showToast('❌ Failed to submit issue report.', 'error');
      });
    }

    function handleLogout() {
      sessionStorage.clear();
      window.location.replace('/');
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

FILE: README.md
